finite_regression.method: exact integer enumeration over all residues for every unordered pair from primes 2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19
finite_regression.proof_boundary: Finite checks guard formulas and sample pushforward identities; they do not prove the symbolic seed-externalization theorem.

symbolic_certificate.classification: The same public spec supplies an exact external sampler A~Uniform(R_N), so the witness is literally explicit random scalar-presentation sampling followed by a proper gcd test and is rejected by the task firewall.
symbolic_certificate.seed_externalization: For a finite effect program whose realized choices are generated by public exact seed laws and whose branch presentations are public deterministic functions Phi of sampled seeds and explicit input presentations, sampling those same seeds externally and recursively applying Phi produces the identical joint law of presentations and hence the identical terminal-readout law.
symbolic_certificate.witness_branch_opacity: The public pre-readout transcript is identical for every A, while A=1,p,q,0 (used only as proof witnesses) produce support empty,p-only,q-only,both respectively. Actual realized support is not a deterministic function of the public transcript.
symbolic_certificate.witness_probability: Under uniform A mod pq, the residue counts for gcd(N,A)=1,p,q,N are respectively (p-1)(q-1), q-1, p-1, 1; proper-factor probability is (p+q-2)/(pq).
symbolic_certificate.witness_support: For H_A=coker([A]) over R_N with N=pq squarefree, H_A tensor F_ell is nonzero iff ell|A; therefore gcd(N,A) is exactly the product of supported hidden primes.

tool_reuse_resolution.reuse_note: The effect is audited as a public weighted relation/correspondence from input/spec to presentation branches. T8's separation of relation branching from observable nondeterminism is retained; the present theorem adds the task-local pushforward/externalization proof.

unresolved_residue: Whether there exists a fully public-N, non-oracular realized effect whose exact branch is hidden and whose public semantics also cannot be effectively externalized to an enumerable/sampleable family or distribution of explicit support-bearing presentations, without importing a reviewed classical factor mechanism.
